lines.en: Nine builders built a bridge,
nine builders, nine brothers,
they built a bridge near Kratovo
across the Manceva river.

lines.cyr: Дење го ѕидат, ноќе мост им паѓа
lines.lat: Denje go dzidat, noḱe most im paǵa
lines.en: By day they built the bridge, but at night it broke down.
The brothers made a commitment

lines.cyr: која ќе снаа утре да дојде
lines.lat: koja ḱe snaa utre da dojde
lines.en: that the bride who would come the next day
to bring a meal to the builders

lines.cyr: нејзе ќе ја в' темел заѕидаме
lines.lat: nejze ḱe ja v' temel zadzidame
lines.en: would be built into the base of the bridge

lines.cyr: да ни затрае мост на реката.
lines.lat: da ni zatrae most na rekata.
lines.en: to fasten it to the river.
When they came home that night
they all informed there wives,

lines.cyr: само не ѝ кажа најмалото братче
lines.lat: samo ne ì kaža najmaloto bratče
lines.en: only the youngest one did not,

lines.cyr: он не ѝ кажа на Рада невеста.
lines.lat: on ne ì kaža na Rada nevesta.
lines.en: he did not speak to his bride Rada.
Rada stood up to prepare a meal
and brought the lunch to the builders.
When the young brother saw Rada,

lines.cyr: викнало оно на глас да плаче.
lines.lat: viknalo ono na glas da plače.
lines.en: he cried out with lamenting voice.
When the brothers grabbed Rada
and built her into the base,

lines.cyr: Рада на девери милно се моли:
lines.lat: Rada na deveri milno se moli:
lines.en: Rada begged her brothers-in-law,
to let at least her right breast in the open.
At least leave my right breast in the open

lines.cyr: за да си надојам машкото дете.
lines.lat: za da si nadojam maškoto dete.
lines.en: so I can give it to my little son.
And they let it in the open

lines.cyr: за да си надои Рада единче.
lines.lat: za da si nadoi Rada edinče.
lines.en: so she could nourish the little boy.
